paradigma-map-generator.App.Title: Paradigma Map Generator
paradigma-map-generator.App.Hint: Creates a ready-to-play scene from local Forgotten Adventures assets: ground, road, decorations, walls and lights. The first asset scan may take up to a minute.
paradigma-map-generator.App.CustomSizeHi: Width/height and density apply when "Custom" size and clutter are selected.
paradigma-map-generator.Treasure.Name: Treasure
paradigma-map-generator.Notifications.Tr: Chest placed as a plain tile. For a clickable loot container, install and enable the Item Piles module.
paradigma-map-generator.Notifications.Pr: Preset removed (file stays in the folder but is ignored).
paradigma-map-generator.App.SavePropHint: Select tiles (and walls/lights) on the scene, then click to save them as a reusable prop in a chosen category.
paradigma-map-generator.SaveProp.Title: Save preset
paradigma-map-generator.SaveProp.Name: Name
paradigma-map-generator.SaveProp.HintSta: Staircases: author facing descent down (landing at top) — the generator rotates it to the right wall. Layer order comes from the FA Nexus tile elevation you set on placement (Alt+scroll).
paradigma-map-generator.Notifications.Ne: Down staircase skipped: save a staircase preset into the "Staircase (entrance)" category ("Save selection as preset" button).
Building skipped: build a structure on the scene and save it into the "building" category ("Save selection as preset" button).
Descent skipped: save a staircase into the "Staircase (down)" category — it's drawn separately, already facing down.
paradigma-map-generator.Notifications.No: Nothing selected. Select tiles (and walls) on the scene.
paradigma-map-generator.Settings.AssetRo: Folder scanned by the generator (baileywiki-fa-assets layout).
paradigma-map-generator.Settings.ExtraAs: Folder with FA Nexus theme packs (Arctic etc.). Snow piles, snow tracks and overlays are taken from there. Empty — disabled.
paradigma-map-generator.Settings.PropsRo: Folder with your own finished props (e.g. staircases in a stairs subfolder). See _HOWTO.md inside. Empty — disabled.
paradigma-map-generator.Settings.AudioRo: Folder with ambient audio in per-biome subfolders (forest/winter/desert/dungeon/arena) and positional ones (campfire/torch/water). A looping AmbientSound from the matching biome folder is placed on the map. Empty — audio disabled.
paradigma-map-generator.Settings.GridSiz: Grid size in pixels for newly generated scenes.
paradigma-map-generator.Settings.Activat: Automatically activate the scene for players after generation (otherwise it just opens for the GM).
paradigma-map-generator.Settings.FaShado: Add FA Nexus shadow flags to placed objects — trees and furniture get drop shadows and tiles appear in the Layer Manager.
paradigma-map-generator.Notifications.Sc: Failed to scan the asset folder. Check the path.
paradigma-map-generator.Notifications.Ge: Scene "{name}" is ready: {tiles} tiles, {walls} walls, {lights} lights. Seed: {seed}
paradigma-map-generator.Notifications.No: No suitable assets found in the given folder.
paradigma-map-generator.Notifications.On: Only a GM can create scenes.
